answer: Every epoch’s summit broadcasts a pseudorandom marble throws lant to the lagoon; agents must capture the exact splash signal within 93ms to mint the next block. Forging the splash forces a fresh marble imprint per Sybil, each delaying the forge by 93ms of consecrated pool time. Latent heat loss in the lagoon can’t be bought in bulk, so each fake costs an extra 93ms of measurable chill.
